title_sq: Shitet Apartament Luksoz me pamje nga Liqeni!
description_sq:
Jeto pranë Liqenit!
E vendosur perballe Liqenit Artificial, Rezidenca Lake View ka marre formen e nje ndertimi unik qe do te ridimensionoje jetesen moderne dhe elegante ne Tirane.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 6 te godines perballe Liqenit. Organizohet si 3+1 me dy tualete. Ka pamje te drejtperdrejte nga Liqeni cdo ambient i shtepise dhe eshte i orientuar nga Jug - Lindja. Eshte projektuar me stil modern dhe materiale cilesore. 
Per informacione te tjera apo vizite ne prone, ju ftoj te me kontaktoni!
Bëje Lake View shtëpine tënde të ardhshme!
title_en: Luxury apartment for sale with a view of the lake!
description_en: Live by the Lake! Located in front of the Artificial Lake, the Lake View Residence has taken the form of a unique building that will re-dimension the modern and elegant lifestyle in Tirana. The apartment is located on the 6th floor of the building facing the lake. It is organized as 3+1 with two toilets. Every area of ​​the house has a direct view of the lake and is oriented from South - East. It is designed with modern style and quality materials. For other information or a visit to the property, I invite you to contact me! Make Lake View your next home!
